$meta.description: Corner geometry, radii and the concentric rule. Apple corners are continuous (superellipse), never plain circular arcs.

sources.wwdc25: WWDC25 Liquid Glass and design system sessions: concentric shapes
sources.estimate: measured from kit components, verify in kit Inspect

continuousCorner.$usage: Every rounded rectangle uses a continuous corner. CSS: border-radius R plus corner-shape: squircle where supported, else the SVG squircle path generator. Flutter: ContinuousRectangleBorder is NOT equal, use the plugin's SquircleBorder. Figma equivalent: corner smoothing 60 percent.
continuousCorner.note: A continuous corner of radius R visually reads smaller than a circular corner of radius R. Do not shrink R to compensate.

capsule.usage: Buttons with text, search fields, segmented controls, toggles, tab bar, toolbar groups, badges, tags

circle.usage: Icon-only buttons (close, more, back on iOS 26+), avatars

roundedRect.usage: Cards, sheets, list sections, alerts, popovers, windows, text fields on macOS

concentric.$usage: MANDATORY. A shape nested inside another shape uses innerRadius = max(outerRadius - padding, minimumInner). This is what makes Liquid Glass layouts look Apple-made.
concentric.example: Window radius 12, toolbar button inset 6 from window edge: button radius 6 if rect, or capsule when height allows. Sheet radius 38 with 16 padding: inner card 22.

radiusIOS.sheet: device display radius when full height at the bottom edge; 38 when floating at medium detent with 8 inset

radiusMacOS.$source: estimate from macOS 27 kit and reports, verify
radiusMacOS.windowNote: macOS 27 uses one uniform window radius for all apps. Tahoe used 16 to 26 depending on toolbar. Verify exact value against the kit Windows page before shipping.
radiusMacOS.pushButtonRegular: capsule on Liquid Glass toolbars; 6 in content area

hairline.usage: Separators and glass rims on 2x and 3x screens. On 1x Windows screens render 1px at half alpha instead.

borders.rule: Apple almost never draws visible borders around content. Separation comes from material, background level, and spacing. Never add a 1px gray border to cards or inputs on iOS.
